notes.subject: אפריון
notes.rationale: Palanquin — the word appears only here in the Tanakh; meaning gathered from context and cognates.

notes.subject: apiron
notes.rationale: Renderings split between palanquin/litter (ylt, jps) and chariot/palace (kjv, geneva); palanquin kept as the literal picture.

notes.subject: לו
notes.rationale: Read as 'for himself' (reflexive benefit); 'for it' (the palanquin's parts) is a second reading carried into v10.

translation: Apiron (dɔgɔtigi taamabaga) kelen, masakɛ Shelomo (Sulɛman) y'a dilan a yɛrɛ ma, ni Lebanɔn jiriw ye.
